full_details: You rehearsed at nine and played at two. The throat was worse than Tuesday. The Rose bill was the Wise Man, and you did not go. At the Bell, Gilbert had already brought the parcel from the house. You paid Hobbins sixpence for the parcel and twopence for the letter that asks the question. He has six horses. The ruts are iron, and he walked the last mile in. He watered the horses before he would turn a bag out. Nothing from Stratford was put in your hand. At home you wrote the eightpence on your tables. Edith's eight shillings is still there, unpaid, till Lady Day.
one_sentence: You played the Knave, and afterwards you paid the carrier eightpence.
title: Paid the carrier eightpence
